limits: The live-site observations of this page are single requests made on 2026-10-12 through the build machine's proxy with requests 2.34.2, beautifulsoup4 4.15.0, Python 3.14.6; web sites change and nothing re-checks it.

pypi.org's search page, fetched by requests on 2026-10-12, answered status 200 with the title 'Client Challenge' and 0 elements of the class package-snippet, so the chapter's searchpypi.py opens no tab on today's site; the program was run against a local stand-in results page to show it working.

rj.txt, the file the chapter downloads in chunks, was 174126 bytes long on 2026-10-12 (chunks [100000, 74126]) where the chapter prints 178978 bytes (chunks [100000, 78978]); the page's own example uses a 178978-byte stand-in.

urllib.robotparser answers differently by release: for 'Disallow: /search*' the search page was allowed under Python 3.14.0, 3.14.1, 3.14.2, 3.14.3, 3.14.4 and refused from 3.14.5 (the 7 releases 3.14.0 to 3.14.6, recorded on 2026-10-12 with each release installed by uv); the page's in-browser Python is Pyodide's CPython 3.13, so its robots.txt examples use plain prefix rules, which every release reads alike.

The programs that need requests, Beautiful Soup, Selenium or Playwright were run on the build machine under Python 3.14.6 (23 recorded runs in third_party_record_v1_0_1.json, local fixtures only); those programs need a network and a site to reach, which a browser tab running Python cannot offer, so the page's Chapter examples use the standard library alone, and the last one shows that importing Selenium fails.

Not executed in the build environment: a window on a screen (this machine has no display, so every browser ran headless and a headed launch was seen to fail), the clipboard of pyperclip, a real OpenWeather key (the fake key of the chapter was sent and answered with 401; a stand-in service on this machine answered the programs), Chrome and Safari engines, a browser reaching the live https sites (the browser here does not trust the build proxy's certificate), and the game 2048.
